title: GST Registration Cancellation Made Simpler: Ab Automatic Cancellation Sabke Liye!
content:
# GST Registration Cancellation Made Simpler: Ab Automatic Cancellation Sabke Liye!

Ek important update hai! Government ne GST registration cancellation ke process ko aur bhi aasan bana diya hai. Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne announce kiya hai ki ab eligible taxpayers ke liye GST registration ka automatic cancellation December 1, 2026 se shuru ho jayega.

Is naye update se pehle ki kuch conditions hata di gayi hain, jisse ye process aur streamline ho gaya hai.

*   **Effective Date:** Ye naye provisions December 1, 2026 se lagu honge.
*   **Conditions Simplified:** Ab GST registration ke automatic cancellation ke liye ₹2.5 Lakh ka threshold aur GSTR-10 filing ki pehle wali condition remove kar di gayi hai. Iska matlab hai ki ab automatic cancellation tab hoga jab taxpayer ne saari required returns time par file ki ho aur sabhi outstanding tax dues pay kar diye hon.
*   **Official Notification:** Ye changes Central Goods and Services Tax (Second Amendment) Rules, 2026 ke through laye gaye hain, jise Notification No. 08/2026–Central Tax dated November 25, 2026 dwara notify kiya gaya hai.
*   **Process:** Jahan saari returns submit ho gayi hain aur outstanding liabilities (tax, interest, fee, penalty, and any other amount) clear ho chuki hain, wahan registration electronically cancel ho jayega. Cancellation intimation FORM GST REG-38 mein electronically communicate ki jayegi. Jin cases mein returns pending hain ya dues unpaid hain, unhe proper officer ke paas examination ke liye refer kiya jayega.
